id: title:MattPua:show eight items per project section

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the maximum number of items displayed on the AI-first homepage grid and adds tests to verify this behavior.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 adds necessary imports to support the grid item display, while P1.F1.H2 both changes the grid item limit from 5 to 8 and adds a corresponding test. This represents a substantive, bounded change to the homepage's display capability and its verification.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and test changes, not on unverified adoption or broader systemic impact. The score does not account for the number of PRs or lines, nor does it infer benefits not demonstrated in the code.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change for the AI-first homepage. P1.F2.H1 changes a grid item limit from 5 to 8. P1.F1.H2 adds a test asserting that pinned dashboards, recents, and starred items are shown up to 8. P1.F1.H1 adds imports for the models and types used in P1.F2.H2. No score assigned.
